components.notes: Support (board AdminSupport) in the quiet register: guest and organizer conversations from WhatsApp, Instagram and logged email, longest waiting first, in a CatchTable on the queue pattern with Open, Mine, Waiting on them and Closed views. The conversation beside it shows who it is, how long they have waited, its links to a booking, money issue or safety case, the messages, saved replies, and recording a reply or note. The WhatsApp reply trial stays reachable at /support/trial.
Lazy live route wrapper owns the support inbox controller and the conversation URL; deterministic prop-driven visual coverage remains on route_support.
